candidates.api_shape: helicograph(arm_len, wheel_d, phase_deg) -> {arm, wheel, tracer} Archimedean spiral, 507 #384
candidates.fdm: A radial arm, a rolling wheel that also slides. Prints. Pose is wheel angle; r = k*theta.
candidates.name: helicograph
candidates.why: The spiral tracer. 507's named helicograph. Not a pantograph (scale) and not a mainspring (energy). Teaching + a printable volute generator.

candidates.api_shape: proportional_dividers(leg_len, pivot_frac) -> two crossed legs, ratio = pivot_frac
candidates.fdm: Two bars, one sliding pivot. Prints flat. 507 #405 proportion compasses.
candidates.name: proportional_dividers
candidates.why: Similar-triangles scaler. The pocket pantograph. Distinct from pantograph_linkage (a parallelogram that copies a path).

candidates.api_shape: centrolinead(arm_a, arm_b) -> two rulers + a T that aims at a hidden vanishing point, 507 #408
candidates.fdm: Three bars. Prints. Perspective drawing cell.
candidates.name: centrolinead
candidates.why: Draws lines through an inaccessible point. Named 507 instrument. Niche but a real cell.

candidates.api_shape: a rolling circle with a tracer, 507 #403-404
candidates.fdm: A disc that rolls on a line or a circle. Prints. Cycloid / hypocycloid tracer.
candidates.name: cyclograph
candidates.why: Rolling-circle curve. tusi_couple is the 2:1 hypocycloid line; this is the general rolling tracer.

candidates.name: trammel_again
candidates.why: Archimedes ellipsograph / double-slider. 507 #152. Do not claim it twice. Ship it under straight-line.

candidates.api_shape: a bar with two points, one a pivot
candidates.fdm: Too thin. Two pins on a bar.
candidates.name: beam_compass
candidates.why: A large compass. After proportional_dividers, skip.

candidates.name: cmm_plotter
candidates.why: CMM / plotter / drafting machine. Product. The cells are ways and tracers.

rejected.name: chebyshev_plantigrade_as_instrument
rejected.why: A walking machine, not a drawing instrument. Already on the six-bar slice.

summary:
A drawing instrument is a 1-DoF (or 2-DoF) linkage whose coupler traces a named curve. 507 is an instrument shelf: ellipsograph 152, helicograph 384, cyclograph 403-404, proportion compasses 405, parabola instrument 406, centrolinead 408, bisecting gauge 410. IFToMM treats these as function generators. A CMM or a plotter is a product.

Catalog already has the scaling tracer: pantograph_pose / pantograph_linkage. straight-line already proposed trammel (Archimedes ellipsograph / double-slider) as fit=yes. four_bar_coupler_point (proposed) traces a general coupler curve, not a named instrument. Grep finds no helicograph, centrolinead, proportional dividers, or cyclograph.

FDM reality. helicograph is a wheel that rolls around a fixed point while sliding on a radial arm, tracing an Archimedean spiral (507 #384); prints as an arm + a rolling wheel. proportional_dividers are two legs with an adjustable pivot, similar triangles; prints, the instrument version of a pantograph ratio. centrolinead is two rulers plus a T that draws lines through a hidden vanishing point (perspective). cyclograph is a rolling circle that draws a cycloid. trammel is already claimed on the straight-line slice; do not re-rank it as a new discovery. A beam compass is two rods and a pivot, too thin. Do not emit a drafting machine or a CNC plotter.
title: Drawing instruments and kinematic tracers
